resources.string: Import local models supported by LiteRT-LM or llama.cpp. Model names are unrestricted. Available image and audio actions are determined from model capabilities. For multimodal GGUF, add the matching mmproj file and select it for the language model. A text-only model does not support image or audio actions. GGUF runs on CPU. Model compatibility and memory requirements depend on the model and device.
Load an audio-capable AI model first.
